title: Does anyone have a wooden apartment building in some strange desert-like area named "Mexico" in their dreamscape/Mallworld? (For context, I've never even been to Mexico or any similar places in real life)
content: I've just remembered yet ANOTHER Mallworld dream. Ever since I found this sub, I've been remembering more and more of them from months ago. I didn't even realize most of them were Mallworld dreams until I found out it was a thing. I just remembered the one I mentioned in the title, and it stuck out to me for some reason. These 2 random girls were also there with me and dared me to pee off of the edge of some balcony into the sand (not sure why, lol) and I luckily declined. Anyways, has anyone in this sub dreamt anything similar to this?
